title: rx2cpp ooRexx-to-C++ compiler: engineering and continuity
purpose: Let an LLM continue work on rx2cpp, the ooRexx 5.3 to C++17 compiler (architecture: Tom Dyer; coding: ChatGPT and Claude), without re-learning its rules: output byte-identical to the interpreter, the interpreter's own algorithms ported rather than approximated, how to build, test and qualify it, how its runtime cooperates with the interpreter (epoch, environment symbols, security managers), what is known to differ, and the lessons that cost time.

sections.title: Start / current baseline and standing rules
Architecture: lanes, native objects, interpreter cooperation
